<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Flying Flame](/Feats.aspx?ID=4238) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 28

</column>

---

A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice—such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere. It Flies from you up to 30 feet in a path you choose. Each creature it passes through takes 1d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. A creature attempts only one save, even if the flame passes through it multiple times.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.
name: Flying Flame
